final: SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS average_daily_price, AVG(avg_daily_price - overall_average) AS average_above_overall FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_daily_price FROM film WHERE rating IS NOT NULL AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating) AS rating_averages CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS overall_average FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_daily_price FROM film WHERE rating IS NOT NULL AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating) AS all_rating_averages) AS overall WHERE avg_daily_price > overall_average
